name: LVIS: Large Vocabulary Instance Segmentation
description: A landmark benchmark for large-vocabulary and long-tailed object detection and instance segmentation, created by Facebook AI Research (FAIR) and Carnegie Mellon University. Annotates 164,000 images from the Microsoft COCO dataset with 2.2 million high-quality instance segmentation masks across 1,203 categories. Designed specifically to reflect the natural power-law distribution of visual concepts where common objects have thousands of instances while rare categories appear only a few times.
